segments.speaker: clinician
segments.text: Good afternoon. And you must be here with your daughter today?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Yes, this is my daughter, she's been helping me keep track of things.

segments.speaker: family
segments.text: Hi, yeah, I just wanted to sit in since she mentioned the dizziness again.

segments.speaker: clinician
segments.text: Of course, glad you're here. When did the dizziness start?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: Maybe two weeks ago, on and off.

segments.speaker: family
segments.text: It's been worse in the mornings, from what I've seen.

segments.speaker: clinician
segments.text: Does it feel like the room is spinning, or more like lightheadedness?

segments.speaker: patient
segments.text: More lightheaded, like I might fall over.

segments.speaker: family
segments.text: She did almost fall in the kitchen last Tuesday.

segments.speaker: clinician
segments.text: Okay, that's important. Let's check your blood pressure sitting and standing.
